onboarding.slide1Title: From the farm to the market
onboarding.slide1Text: Sell your products directly to buyers, with no middlemen.
onboarding.slide2Title: Take care of your farm with data
onboarding.slide2Text: Simple sensors tell you when to water and warn you about risks on your land.
onboarding.slide3Text: Fair prices, more buyers, and the support of the AgriLink community.

home.description: AgriLink connects farmers directly to buyers, monitors their farms with IoT sensors, and uses data to recommend the best time to irrigate, harvest, and sell.
home.marketplaceDescription: Sell directly to buyers, distributors, and consumers, with no middlemen.
home.iotDescription: Low-cost sensors measure soil moisture, temperature, water level, and environmental conditions in real time.
home.aiDescription: The platform analyzes the collected data and suggests when to irrigate, warns of risks, and forecasts production.
